ledger.x: 825: Cliopatria's Kingdom of Brittany begins on the Breton core.
850: the Bretons seize the Frankish Breton March.
851: Jengland and Angers end the contest.
851: Erispoe wins Rennes, Nantes and Retz at Angers and a royal title.
863: Salomon's peace at Entrammes recognises western Anjou as Breton.
867: Salomon is granted Avranches and Coutances.
933: the Avranchin and the Cotentin go to Normandy.
939: the kingdom gives way to the duchy.

wars.name: Nominoe's and Erispoe's wars against Charles the Bald
wars.outcome: Nominoe beat Frankish troops at Ballon (845), resumed the offensive in 849, occupied the Breton March in 850 and took the garrisons of Rennes and Nantes in 851; Erispoe won at Jengland on 22 August 851 and the Treaty of Angers (September 851) gave him Rennes…

wars.name: Salomon's wars with Charles the Bald
wars.outcome: Entrammes (863) recognised western Anjou as Breton; Compiegne (August 867) brought the counties of Avranches and Coutances; in 868 Charles gave Salomon regalia.

wars.name: Breton civil war after Salomon's murder
wars.outcome: Pascweten, Gurvand and Wigo killed Salomon in 874; civil war until 876, when Pascweten and Gurvand died and Alan I took power.

wars.name: Alan I's wars against the Vikings
wars.outcome: Judicael died at Questembert in 888 or 889; Alan defeated the Vikings at Saint-Lo in 890.

wars.name: Norse occupation and reconquest of Brittany
wars.outcome: Brittany completely occupied by the Norsemen from 919; Alan II landed in 935, had recovered most of Brittany by 937, and a Frankish-Breton army attacked the Norse fortress of Trans-la-Foret in 939; he became duke.

certainty.note: The Breton marches against the Franks are approximate; no page gives a boundary.

The Angers settlement (851) and the peaces of Entrammes (863) and Compiegne (867) name counties (Rennes, Nantes, Retz, western Anjou, Avranches, Coutances), not survey lines, so they stay soft; the Vire is named as the eastern limit under…
